summary: Common early-game water sources, their properties, and risks.

items.description: Fresh, clean water.  Truly the best thing to quench your thirst.
uses: Sealed bottles from fridges, labs, or crafted via boiling.

items.description: Water, the stuff of life, necessary for all kinds of crafting, cleaning, and avoiding an agonizing death by dehydration.  You should boil or purify it before using it as drinking water.
uses: Found in toilets, rivers, pools, rain barrels; boil or purify before drinking.

items.description: Fancy mineral water, so fancy it makes you feel fancy just holding it.
uses: Store-bought bottled water; morale bump for luxury drink.

items.description: A carbonated soft drink which contains quinine, giving it a bitter flavor.  Originally used as a prophylactic against malaria, this modern variant is unsuitable for this purpose as it contains much less quinine and is also sweetened.
uses: Contains quinine; mixes with spirits, minor morale bonus.

items.description: Water with sugar or honey added.  Tastes okay.
uses: Boiled water with sugar/honey; quick morale bump for early mornings.

items.description: Water with salt added.  Not good for drinking.
uses: Use only for crafting (salting hides); drinking increases thirst.

items.description: Turbid liquid from the sewers with an awful stench.
uses: Emergency only: boil twice and dose charcoal tablets before drinking.
